comandi.test: : {test}; NO_COLOR=1 CI=true npx vitest run --testTimeout=60000 --hookTimeout=60000 -t '^(?!.*(uses the request ip when no x-forwarded-for header set|response stream: client abort propagates to (source stream|cancel)|response stream: source error terminates response (without crashing|gracefully)) \(node\))'; r=$?; case $r in 0) e=PASS ;; 1) e=FAIL ;; *) e=BLOCKED ;; esac; echo "vitest-fast: esito=$e (vitest exit $r)"; exit $r

lint.comando: npx oxlint {file} && npx oxfmt --check {file}; r=$?; case $r in 0) e=PASS ;; 1) e=FAIL ;; *) e=BLOCKED ;; esac; echo "vitest-fast: esito=$e (oxlint and oxfmt exit $r)"; exit $r
